annotations.title: Household savings in Poland: financial assets by instrument, invested share, Poland vs OECD

description: Use for how much money households in Poland hold and where: cash, bank deposits, bonds, shares, investment funds, insurance and pension savings, the share outside cash and deposits, and Poland against OECD countries. Give NBP (via the ECB) and OECD as sources and the quarter or year. Financial assets of households in Poland at the end of each quarter since 2003 from the quarterly financial accounts compiled by NBP and published by the ECB (QSA): total, cash, deposits, debt securities, equity, investment funds, life insurance, pension entitlements and other, in PLN billion with shares and year-on-year change; finwire_household_invested_share (finwire Working Savings Share: share of financial assets outside cash and deposits, i.e. debt securities, equity and funds, insurance and pension entitlements); Poland among countries in the OECD financial dashboard (share of currency and deposits with rank, equity, funds, pension; net financial worth per person in USD PPP); investment funds, PPK, IKE and IKZE and retail savings bond sales from other finwire datasets.

quarters.description: Number of past quarters in the summary, default 8.
